question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_requirements AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY id) as line_num,
           SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY id) as cum_qty
    FROM orderlines 
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_warehouse1 AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.location_id, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position, 
           i.purchase_id, p.purchased, i.qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY i.product_id 
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.location_id
           ) as pick_order
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1 AND i.product_id IN (4280, 6520)
),
requirements_with_pick_order AS (
    SELECT o.product_id, o.line_num, o.cum_qty,
           i.location_id, i.warehouse, i.aisle, i.position, i.pick_order, i.qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.product_id ORDER BY i.pick_order) as inv_order
    FROM order_requirements o
    CROSS JOIN inventory_warehouse1 i
    WHERE o.product_id = i.product_id
),
running_totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, line_num, cum_qty, location_id, warehouse, aisle, position, 
           pick_order, qty, inv_order,
           SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY inv_order) as total_picked
    FROM requirements_with_pick_order
)
SELECT product_id, location_id, warehouse, aisle, position, 
       CASE 
           WHEN total_picked <= qty THEN LEAST(qty, cum_qty)
           WHEN cum_qty - total_picked + qty <= 0 THEN 0
           ELSE LEAST(cum_qty - total_picked + qty, qty)
       END as pick_qty
FROM running_totals
WHERE total_picked <= cum_qty OR total_picked > qty
ORDER BY product_id, inv_order
